roster_note: Single storey, stove, veranda, garden. Replaces `split_level_house`.
residential_program: a single-storey dwelling of two or three rooms around a masonry stove
an enclosed veranda or storm porch at the entrance
a garden plot with beds, a water butt and a compost corner
a timber outbuilding for tools and fuel
a fence of mismatched boards enclosing the plot
circulation: one entrance through the storm porch
the plot is entered from a track, not a road
damage_constraints: the roof has partly fallen at the ridge; the stove and its flue still stand
the garden has gone to seed but its bed lines are still readable
derive all damage and occupation only from the immutable clean master
use an authored fracture with a gravity-consistent rubble apron, never a cleared box and never per-block random deletion

required_manual_checks: the building reads as informal and individually built, unlike everything else in the region
the stove is the obvious centre of the plan
